name: The Squadron Sinister

Flying, haste
Other Villains you control get +2/+2 and have flying and haste.
Mayhem {3}{U}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for {3}{U}{R} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.)

needs.what: a card-level alternative cost, castable from the graveyard for the printed mayhem price ({3}{U}{R}), offered only while this card is in the graveyard because its owner discarded it this turn (a per-card 'discarded this turn' mark that clears at end of turn), timing rules unchanged; the card goes wherever it normally would on resolution (a permanent to the battlefield, no exile rider)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `graveyard_cost` is an alternative graveyard price but is offered unconditionally, with no condition slot; the `cast_from_graveyard` static takes a condition but casts at the printed price ({5}{U}{R}), not {3}{U}{R}; no condition or static condition key reads whether this card was discarded this turn (only aggregate values like cards_to_graveyard_this_turn). `madness` is the nearest discard-keyed cost but triggers on the discard itself and casts from exile. The other lines (Flying, haste; the Villain anthem via buff + grant_keyword statics with subtypes Villain and exclude_self) are expressible
